uxIssue.problem: Language detection currently treats any non-/en/ non-/criticism/ route as Maithili. Therefore the existing English-only When Dreams Merge and Water-Burial guide roots can be labelled as Maithili even though their content is English; criticism sends its Maithili switch to the homepage rather than a real paired page.
uxIssue.fix: Replace heuristic routing with explicit per-family edition routes as each real counterpart is added.

completionRule: Do not mark the repository bilingual-complete until needsCounterpart is empty and the generated route audit passes with root/default lang=mai and /en/ lang=en for every paired site family.
